what: At the start of the build the app was down: the probe spec got ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on localhost:8181. judo.sh status reported Keycloak not running and its image missing, so the builder had to docker start the Postgres container, run judo.sh start in the background and sleep 140 s.
why: The stack was stopped between rounds; judo.sh status gives no restart recipe and Keycloak image state is not explained.
workaround: docker start postgres-webshop; nohup ./judo.sh start; sleep 140; curl check returned 200.

what: kb_get on best-practices/model/token-based-verification-workflow.md with section 'Public entry points need an anonymous actor' returned not found, though kb_search had returned that path and heading as hit 1. The file exists on disk.
why: Same stale-index window as c11-03, or the section lookup failed on a heading containing a hyphenated word.
workaround: kb_search on anonymous actor, then grep of the file from bash.

what: kb_get on best-practices/frontend/i18n-generator-override-extra-fragment.md with section 'Practice' returned not found, though kb_search returned the path (hit 1). The same path without a section worked two calls later.
why: Section lookup by the name 'Practice' fails for this file; a path-only fetch works.
workaround: Fetched the path without a section (L6272) and read the file from disk with read tool (L6275).

what: kb_get on agent-docs/backend/README.md with section '.generator-ignore - One Rule' returned not found, although kb_search had listed that heading for this path. The One Rule text the builder needed came back from agent-docs/frontend/README.agent.md, which is a different file.
why: The path/heading pair from the search hit does not resolve; the same wording exists in the frontend README.
workaround: kb_get on agent-docs/frontend/README.agent.md with the 'Understanding .generator-ignore > One Rule' section worked (L6249).

what: kb_get on agent-docs/integration-testing/best-practices.agent.md with the heading path 'best-practices.md - index > Best Practices > 5. Logging and Debugging > 6. Test Isolation' returned not found. kb_search showed '6. Test Isolation' nested under 'best-practices.md - index > Best Practices > 5. Logging and Debugging', so the path given was wrong.
why: Heading path not as indexed; numbered headings in the breadcrumb make the chain hard to build from a search hit.
workaround: Read the Test Isolation section from disk with grep (L6343).

what: The kb guard fired repeatedly ('3 consecutive searches without consulting the knowledge base', 'Repeated source searching, still no kb consult') on bash/ctx_execute greps of catalog files that had been used because kb_get failed. About nine warnings in the chunk.
why: The guard counts disk reads of catalog files as source searches; kb_get misses (c11-03 to c11-11) pushed the builder to disk reads, which then triggered the guard.
workaround: Kept running kb_search after each warning; continued reading catalog files from disk (about 14 times in this chunk, e.g. L6110, L6112, L6137, L6275, L6283, L6290, L6313, L6349).

what: judo CLI query --where accepted only KEY=VALUE pairs; the operator form fqn~DashboardInfo was rejected with a format error.
why: The CLI supports equality only; the error gives the format but not the list of supported operators.
workaround: Used grep on the full query output instead.

what: Every kb_search in the R16 re-check returned the warning '(index refresh still running, results may be stale)'. The hits were usable, but the warning stayed on every call.
why: The kb index was still refreshing at the start of the session; no wait or status check was done before searching.
workaround: Used the hits anyway and noted the warning in RECHECK-R16.md.

what: kb_get with a guessed section name 'Practice' returned '(not found: ...)' for best-practices/backend/external-api-adapter-pattern.md and for best-practices/backend/quartz-scheduled-job.md. The real headings are 'External API Adapter with Factory Provider' and 'Practice > Practice notes: scheduler activator, jobs, own transactions'.
why: The builder guessed the heading. kb_get does not list valid headings when the section is not found.
workaround: Retried with the headingPath copied from kb_search json.

what: kb_get with a path and no section returned an empty stub ('pass section to fetch one', '+11 more sections') for best-practices/backend/AGENTS.md and for agent-docs/backend/authentication-guide.agent.md. The builder had to search again.
why: Path-only kb_get on index or companion files returns no body.
workaround: Searched with kb_search for the authentication page instead.

what: kb_search for a generated third-actor frontend build failure ('third actor ... duplicate import') returned no relevant hit. The only related page, the dual-actor practice, says three actors work.
why: No catalog page covers the generator duplicate-import failure, so the search had nothing to match.
workaround: Bisected the model with build -f -i runs (see c12-15).

what: judo query graphql is not available ('Model type graphql is not available').
why: The builder guessed a graphql model type; the CLI has no such type.
workaround: Used judo query esm instead.

what: After update ... --add feature --feature releaseReservations --as rowAction, the table action is named releaseReservationsTableOperation. update on ...Table::releaseReservations then fails with 'error element not found', and the builder had to use the longer FQN.
why: A row action is wrapped in a TableOperation with its own name; the CLI does not explain the FQN.
workaround: Used the TableOperation FQN for label and removal.
proposed_target: judo update --as rowAction (FQN of created element)

what: kb_get on a path without a section returns only the first section and a count of further sections; reading a whole blueprint needs one call per section.
why: Tool returns one section per call for path-only fetches; the agent then has to guess section names.
workaround: Fetched backend.md once, got only the first section, then moved on.
proposed_target: kb_get (return all sections or a section index for path-only fetches)

what: After kb_get returned only blurbs, the agent read catalog files from disk with cat and ctx_execute (cards blueprint, custom-visual-element-override, advanced-patterns, the four custom blueprints).
why: kb did not give the section bodies (same cause as c13-10 and c13-09), so the kb-first rule was broken for the R16U design step.
workaround: Read the catalog on disk under catalog/ and logged it in the round notes.

what: judo CLI graphql rejects where name in [...] on StringFilter (the valid operators listed are contains, endsWith, eq, icontains, iendsWith, iregex, istartsWith, regex, startsWith).
why: StringFilter has no in operator in this CLI version.
workaround: Queried actor types with limit and filtered in Python.

what: Browser CLI find actions failed: find role button --name Products click and find text MY ACCOUNT click are not valid; only click, fill, check, hover and text are accepted.
why: Agent-browser syntax used from memory.
workaround: Used snapshot -i refs and clicked by ref, or opened the URL directly.

what: kb_search {query: "e2e test data hygiene unique names cleanup shared database playwright", limit: 5} returned '(index refresh still running, results may be stale)' (session L7638-L7639).
why: The kb index was being rebuilt when the builder searched.
workaround: Fell back to reading agent-docs/e2e-testing files with ctx_execute.

what: kb_get on the cards-container blueprint returned only the intro line, so the builder read the catalog files from disk.
why: kb_get without a section returns the first section only, and the blueprint's useful sections were not reachable that way.
workaround: Read BLUEPRINT.md and frontend.md from disk (GAPS R16U-1).

what: The email search did not surface the Email Service section of agent-docs; the builder then wrote that agent-docs do not describe the EmailService API and checked the jar with javap.
why: kb_search on email and Handlebars returned blueprint and practice pages, not agent-docs/backend/platform-behavior-reference.agent.md 'Email Service'.
workaround: javap on osgi-email-api jar and unpacked impl class.

what: CLI: 'judo update <BinaryType> --add mimeTypes=X' does not add a second MIME type; the schema keeps only the first value. 'update -s mimeTypes=a,b' also keeps only the first. 'query esm BinaryType --select mimeTypes' needs a subselection.
why: Multi-value MIME list not handled by --add or -s in this CLI build.
workaround: One BinaryType per format: CsvDocument (text/csv) and JsonDocument (application/json).

what: CLI: 'validate --strict' failed after 'fill' of ImportRunInfo with 'NamedElementHaveToBeInApplication ... startImport::FormCall'. Deleting the OperationForm did not clear it; deleting the TableOperation did, and re-adding the operation with 'update <Table> --add feature --feature startImport --as tableAction' passed.
why: Orphan form call left behind by fill after an operation was created on a table.
workaround: Delete the table operation, re-add with --add feature --as tableAction.

what: CLI: 'judo query <Type>' with -m given fails with 'Missing required parameter <typeName>'; the model name has to be a positional 'esm' argument. The usage text does not make this clear.
why: Builder passed -m and then the type, without the model positional.
workaround: Used query esm <Type> --select fqn.

what: kb_get of best-practices files without a section returns only the Intent paragraph and '(+7 more sections)'; kb_search hits of these files carry only the title as headingPath, so no section can be copied. Builder read the files from disk.
why: kb_get path-only answer for best-practices and blueprint files; :meta chunks have no sub-heading.
workaround: Read /Users/bmiller/Projects/judo-blueprint/catalog/... from disk.

what: The kb repeated-search guard fired 14 times in this round ('[kb] Repeated source searching, still no kb consult') while the builder ran build, log and test commands.
why: Guard counts bash source searches (grep, sed of logs) as source searching; it mis-fires on bulk log and build triage.
workaround: Ran kb_search when prompted; otherwise continued.

what: kb_search '50000 products query performance index filter table paging' returned only a generic Performance Optimization section of production.md.
why: No hit on bulk query performance guidance for large tables.
workaround: Used other searches.

what: kb_search 'database index on attribute identifier unique model rdbms index filter column' returned an unrelated model-screen-layout section; builder fell back to grep of agent-docs.
why: No kb hit for declaring a database index.
workaround: grep in catalog/agent-docs (model, backend, deployment).

what: judo query esm --type failed with Unknown option '--type'; the working form uses --where fqn=.
why: Builder guessed the query option; judo-cli doc does not show query syntax clearly.
workaround: Used query esm --where fqn=... and --select.

what: update of a version info with --add feature failed: feature versionNumber is not a feature of ProductVersionInfo placeable here.
why: Unclear feature placement rules in the CLI for the generated view.
workaround: Changed the view fields instead.

what: The kb repeated-search guard fired 42 more times in this part of the chunk, mostly during build and log triage.
why: Guard mis-fires on bulk build and log work; same as R17.
workaround: Ran kb_search when prompted.

what: judo CLI update -s representationComponent=card: first call with the 3-level element fqn said element not found; the 2-level fqn reported changed but a query still showed TABLE; the lower-case value was accepted silently.
why: Element fqn form and enum case not clear; success message does not show the stored value.
workaround: Re-ran validate, save and generate; the build then passed.
proposed_target: judo CLI update (enum value case and element fqn form)

what: kb guard message Repeated source searching, still no kb consult fired about 50 times over R18 and R19 while the builder kept grepping and reading source; kb_search was used only at a few decision points.
why: Builder did not consult the kb before source searches; the guard is a nudge only.
workaround: None; the builder continued.

what: kb_search hits for blueprints show only the title as headingPath; kb_get path-only returns the intro and +9 more sections, so no section can be addressed; builder read blueprint files from disk.
why: Blueprint sections are not exposed as headings in the search hits.
workaround: Read from disk.
proposed_target: kb_search and kb_get for blueprint sections

what: Schema generate run by hand with mvnd judo-rdbms-schema:generate and many -D flags typed from memory, instead of the documented generate and execute route.
why: Builder did not look up the documented Maven generate and execute goals (baseModelVersion, updateModelVersion) first.
workaround: Generate by hand, then execute.

what: Builder dug through the judo platform config templates jar and the schema CLI help to learn how a fresh database is initialised, instead of consulting the kb first.
why: Catalog answer not looked up before the failure was investigated.
workaround: Restore from dump.

what: A third actor makes the generated Admin dialogs import the same type twice (for example import type { ShopMessage, ShopMessage }), and biome format fails in webshop__admin. The builder's kb search for it found nothing, so it bisected the model by hand. The catalog already has a known-issue entry with the cause and the fix (create the new actor first, --index 0).
why: Generator (Zeta ESM to UI pass runs per actor in model file order; getApiImportsForPage uses a HashSet of ClassType). Builder never searched the kb for the duplicate-import error in this chunk.
workaround: Builder found the index-0 rule by bisection and applied it (Guest created with --index 0, build passed).
proposed_target: catalog/best-practices/frontend/dual-actor-frontend-architecture.md (link the known issue and the actor order rule)

what: create -t TransferObjectType with -s mapping=webshop::Product auto-creates all mapped members ('+157 contained', then '+105 contained'). Builder then added DataMember rows by hand, and validation reported NamedElementIsUniqueInItsContainer and 'Binding ... is mapped by other mapped data members' errors.
why: CLI create of a TO with mapping already populates the members; a manual DataMember create duplicates them. The help text does not say so.
workaround: Deleted the TO with --cascade and re-created it, then added DataMembers with --no-check; final validate passed.

what: GraphQL syntax is not in the help: a filter must be where:{name:{eq:"x"}} (where:{name:"x"} fails), and connection fields need items { } (name on ESM_DataFeatureConnection is undefined). The builder found each by trial error.
why: The graphql help shows no example of the where and connection shape.
workaround: Used where:{name:{eq:...}} and items { } in each query.
proposed_target: catalog graphql/CLI query reference (agent-docs/model) or CLI help

what: kb_get agent-docs/frontend/extension-points.md with section 'Frontend Extension Points > Extra Routes > Dashboard Page' returned (not found). The kb_search parent heading was 'Extra Routes', but 'Dashboard Page' is a top-level section.
why: The heading path returned by kb_search as the parent does not match the section; kb_get needed the top-level heading.
workaround: Read the section from disk with grep (L10310).

what: Builder read catalog files from disk instead of the kb: grep of 'supportGuestAccess' across the catalog, cat of role-landing-redirect-access-filter.md, and read of extension-points.md, although kb_search had returned the Guest Page section.
why: Builder bypassed kb after the read-discipline guard nudged it; no kb_get was made for those sections.
workaround: Used the disk text; the catalog content was correct.

what: The builder made no kb_search or kb_get call in this chunk. The kb guard printed 12 reminders '[kb] Repeated source searching, still no kb consult' and the builder kept grepping and reading the webshop source instead.
why: Builder did not follow the kb-first rule for catalog questions; the guard reminder did not change the behaviour.
workaround: None; the builder answered from source and GAPS.md.

what: judo graphql queries failed: the ESM_DataFeature and ESM_RelationFeature types have no memberType or getterExpression fields on attributes and relations of transferobjecttypes. The builder then used the datamembers query, which works.
why: The builder guessed field names; the schema does not have them on those nested types.
workaround: Query esm { datamembers(limit:3000) { items { fqn memberType getterExpression } } } and grep the fqn.

what: The agent-browser daemon would not start ('Daemon process exited during startup'). After pkill and removing the socket it opened, but later snapshots showed about:blank with 0 data-testid elements, so the screenshots did not show the app reliably.
why: Browser tool state from an earlier run plus a slow SPA load; the builder notes a stale browser keeps an old build.
workaround: Used a Playwright spec (zz-guest-check) for the checks instead of the browser tool.
